searchText: If you have LH debug logs from this occurring please DM them to me 🙏 I would like to investigate it from our side to see if it is the getPayloadBodies methods that are causing strife <@&688101493978562687> Is there an investigation on-going on your side? If there's anything you need to know about LH's behaviour please let us know Can do you one better: debug and trace logs are attached to the issue. <https://github.com/ledgerwatch/erigon/issues/7172> Pari thought this was fixed with latest releases, but both mine and an ethstaker user's testing show the issue persists. ah updating erigon didn't help, but upgrading lighthouse to their latest release helped i.e: LH `v4.0.1-rc0` & erigon `v2.41.0` is still borked. But LH `v4.0.1` and erigon `v2.41.0` seems fine on our system. I tested `4.0.1` with `2.41.0` and so did another user. After ~1 hour on Goerli, issue seen. Fully synced Erigon and Lighthouse <@199561711278227457> , `4.0.1` is literally just a version number change. <https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/commits/stable> If `4.0.1-rc.0` fails so will `4.0.1` definitely got no explanation on my side then :/ I am still syncing the node, earlier it refused to sync but now it does. Perhaps the issue i saw was then unrelated and i'd face yours once the sync is done
